title.zh: AI 写代码越来越快，前端还怎么往下走
title.en: AI writes code faster. Where do I go from here as a frontend developer?

summary.zh: 做页面更快了，接下来的时间该花在哪里？从最近整理 GitHub 和项目演示说起，聊聊我的压力与打算。
summary.en: Making a page is getting easier. Working on my GitHub portfolio has made me think about what to study next, and what still makes me uneasy.

basis.zh: 结合近期 GitHub 主页与项目演示的整理，记录个人想法；文中的练习是接下来准备做的事。
basis.en: Personal reflections from working on my GitHub portfolio and project demos. The exercises described here are plans for further study.

title.zh: 省下时间以后，也会有点不安
title.en: Saving time comes with some unease

paragraphs.zh: 这段时间用 AI 做项目，我的感受挺矛盾。页面生成得快，碰到不熟悉的代码也能随时问，确实方便。可看着原来需要花时间完成的东西，现在很快就能得到一个初版，心里也会有点空：以前花力气学的这些，还值不值得继续学？
paragraphs.en: Using AI on projects has left me with mixed feelings. It helps me put a page together and ask about unfamiliar code as I go. That is useful. Yet seeing a first draft appear so quickly makes me wonder whether the things I spent time learning are still worth studying.

paragraphs.zh: 尤其是前端，变化很容易被看见。输入一段需求，页面就能打开，布局、表单、交互都有了。站在使用者的角度，能用就行，未必会关心这些代码是谁写的。对开发者来说，这件事很难完全没有压力。
paragraphs.en: The change is particularly visible in frontend work. A description can become a page with a layout, forms and interactions. Someone using it may care much more about whether it works than who wrote the code. That is an uncomfortable thought for a developer.

paragraphs.zh: 我也不太相信学会几个 AI 工具，就能从此不焦虑。工具还会变，项目要求也会变。现在比较确定的是，我得学会借助 AI 开发，同时弄明白自己到底在交付什么。
paragraphs.en: I doubt that learning a few AI tools will settle that anxiety. Tools and project requirements will keep changing. For now, I want to get better at using AI while still understanding what I am handing over.

title.zh: 最近改自己的主页，让我想明白了一点
title.en: Working on my own site made this clearer

paragraphs.zh: 最近一直在整理 GitHub 主页，也加了不少项目演示。起初总想多放一点内容，多一些动画，让页面看起来丰富些。后来反复看，还是觉得不够舒服：有的地方字号不合适，有的模块太抢眼，内容放多了，反而找不到重点。
paragraphs.en: I have been working on my GitHub site and adding project demos. At first I kept wanting more content and animation. After several rounds, parts of it still felt awkward: the type size was off, some sections demanded too much attention, and adding more material made it harder to see what mattered.

paragraphs.zh: 这让我意识到，生成页面和把页面做好，花的心思不太一样。AI 可以给出很多方案，但一个第一次进来的人会先看哪里，能不能找到项目入口，手机上读着累不累，这些都得重新看。页面一处处改完，最后还要放在一起检查，不能每个模块单看都挺好，拼起来却像几个网站。
paragraphs.en: Generating a page and making it work well require different kinds of attention. AI can offer plenty of options. I still need to look at where a first-time visitor will start, whether the project links are easy to find, and how the text reads on a phone. Sections also need to work together; a set of attractive pieces can still feel like several unrelated websites.

paragraphs.zh: 功能也是如此。比如一个搜索框，正常输入时能返回结果，还要看看连续搜索会发生什么。前一次请求回来得晚，会不会把后一次的结果盖掉？这种问题藏在操作过程里，靠截图看不出来。我觉得前端经验在这些时候仍然用得上。
paragraphs.en: The same applies to behaviour. A search box may return results for an ordinary query, but what happens when someone searches again before the first request finishes? A late response might replace the newer results. A screenshot cannot show that. This is one place where frontend experience still helps.

title.zh: 接下来，我想换一种学法
title.en: How I want to study from here

paragraphs.zh: 前端我会继续学。不过，再遇到一个新框架，我想先问问自己，手里的项目是不是真的需要它。我更愿意留点时间，把已经用着的东西弄清楚。异步请求为什么会串，组件状态该放在哪一层，浏览器为什么会卡，这些问题一旦没想明白，换个工具通常还会再碰到。
paragraphs.en: I will keep learning frontend development. Before picking up another framework, though, I want to ask whether a project actually needs it. I would like to spend more time understanding the tools already in use: why requests interfere with each other, where component state belongs, or what makes the browser slow. Changing tools does not automatically resolve those questions.

paragraphs.zh: AI 写代码这件事，也得认真练。一个模糊的要求交过去，得到一大批改动，自己看不懂，再继续让它修，我不想把开发做成这样。以后尽量把问题说小一点，先弄清楚现有代码，再让它修改。改完看看差异，亲手跑一遍，遇到解释不通的地方就停下来查。
paragraphs.en: Using AI to write code takes practice too. I do not want to hand over a vague request, receive a large change I cannot follow, and keep asking for fixes. I want to work on smaller problems, understand the existing code first, then read the changes and run them myself. If an explanation does not make sense, I need to stop and investigate.

paragraphs.zh: 还有一些时间，我想花在前端之外。比如页面上的数据从哪里来，接口失败后怎么恢复，AI 生成的回答该怎样展示。如果做一个 AI 应用，只有输入框和一段能返回的文字还不够。用户等待时看到什么，想中途停止怎么办，回答出错后还能不能继续操作，都得有人认真处理。前端和这些环节放在一起学，我觉得会更有意思。
paragraphs.en: I also want to spend some time beyond the frontend itself: where the data comes from, how a failed request recovers, and how an AI response should be presented. An AI application needs more than a text box that returns an answer. What does someone see while waiting? Can they stop it? Can they continue after an error? Studying those parts together with the interface interests me.

paragraphs.zh: 当然，时间有限，我也不可能什么都学透。眼下还是从熟悉的业务系统和交互功能入手，遇到问题再往下补。总比一口气收藏很多教程，过几天又忘了自己准备学什么，要踏实一些。
paragraphs.en: There is only so much time, and I cannot study everything in depth. For now I will start with the business systems and interactions I know, then follow the questions that come up. That feels more manageable than collecting courses and losing track of why I saved them.

title.zh: 先把手头的项目做扎实
title.en: Start with the projects already in hand

paragraphs.zh: 至于前端岗位以后会变成什么样，我现在说不准。重复工作变得容易了，原来靠熟练度积累的一些优势，确实需要重新想想。但我也不愿意因为担心，就把学过的东西全放下。
paragraphs.en: I cannot say what frontend jobs will look like in the future. As routine work gets easier, I need to reconsider some advantages that came from practice. I do not want that uncertainty to make me abandon everything I have learned.

paragraphs.zh: 接下来更新 GitHub，我想少一点为了凑数量而增加的演示，多留一些修改过程。比如一次低代码表单的状态处理，我为什么采用这个方案，AI 提的建议哪里没用上，改完又发现了什么问题。记录不用写得多漂亮，过一段时间再看，能看懂自己当时为什么这么做就够了。
paragraphs.en: For future GitHub updates, I want fewer demos added just to increase the count and more records of changes. For a low-code form, for example, I could explain why I chose a state design, which AI suggestion I left out, and what I found after making the change. The record only needs to be clear enough for me to understand my reasoning when I return to it.

paragraphs.zh: 我还是喜欢把一个想法做成可以点、可以用的东西。AI 让开始这件事容易了很多，后面那些需要耐心的部分，我想继续做下去。下一次就从现有演示里挑一个小问题，修好它，把经过写下来。
paragraphs.en: I still enjoy turning an idea into something people can click and use. AI has made it much easier to begin. I want to keep working on the parts that take patience afterwards. Next time, I will pick a small problem in an existing demo, fix it and write down what happened.
